records.title: Scaling Innovative Tech and Digital Startups in Kenya

records.title: Apply Now: Career Development Program for Artists (Canada)
records.summary: The Career Development Program by the New Brunswick Arts Board (ArtsNB) supports professional artists in New Brunswick by offering financial assistance for artistic growth and career advancement. The program focuses on recognizing talents and encouraging artistic potential through three distinct components. The upcoming deadline for application submissions is 1 March 2027. records.title: Supporting New Art and Health Projects in Sweden
records.summary: The Culture and Health Platform invites professional artists in Sweden to apply for grants supporting innovative projects at the intersection of art and health. This EU-funded initiative, in collaboration with Region Stockholm, Region Västerbotten, and Västra Götalandsregionen, offers three grants of €8,000 each. Applications open on 9 November 2026 and close on 18 December 2026....
